SELECT TRUNC(wl.workout_date) AS workout_date, e.exercise_id, e.exercise_name, e.body_part,
-- 그날 총 볼륨 SUM(NVL(ws.weight, 0) * ws.reps) AS total_volume,
-- 실제로 사용한 최고 중량 MAX(ws.weight) AS max_weight,
-- 예상 1RM (Epley 공식) ROUND( MAX( CASE WHEN ws.weight IS NOT NULL AND ws.weight > 0 AND ws.reps BETWEEN 1 AND 12 THEN ws.weight * (1 + ws.reps / 30) ELSE NULL END ), 1 ) AS estimated_1rm,
-- 총 반복수 SUM(ws.reps) AS total_reps,
-- 총 세트수 COUNT(ws.workout_set_id) AS total_sets
FROM workout_logs wl
JOIN workout_exercises we ON we.workout_log_id = wl.workout_log_id
JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id = we.exercise_id
JOIN workout_sets ws ON ws.workout_exercise_id = we.workout_exercise_id
WHERE wl.member_id = #{memberId} AND wl.updated_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY TRUNC(wl.workout_date), e.exercise_id, e.exercise_name, e.body_part
ORDER BY workout_date, e.exercise_id
